LETTERS of [Jean Baptiste Colbert, Marquis de] Torcy [French Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs] to Card. Gualterio; 19 July, 1700-17 Dec. 1726. Fr. Signed, or holograph. Many in cipher, with deciphering. Two volumes. Paper.

LETTERS of [Henri Charles Arnaud], Abbé de Pomponne [French Ambassador at Venice], to Card. Gualterio; dat. Venice, to the end of 1709, and subsequently at Paris, Versailles, etc., 10 Dec. 1706-5 Jan. 1730. Fr. Holograph, or signed. Many partially in cipher , with decipherings. Two volumes. Paper.

LETTERS of [Michel] Amelot [afterwards Marquis de Gournay] to Card. Gualterio; dated from Madrid, 22 Sept. 1705- 7 March, 1709, while he was French Ambassador in Spain; from Rome, 2 March-31 July, 1715; and from Paris, Issy, Versailles, etc ., 30 Sept. 1715-8 May, 1724. Fr . Partly holograph. Two volumes. Many of the letters in Vol. I. contain portions in cipher , with decipherings, and are unsigned. At f. 104 of Vol. II. is an unsigned letter to Card. Gualterio, dat. Paris, 24 March, 1721, forwarded by M. Amelot; and at f. 308 are drafts of a few letters of Card. Gualterio to M. Amelot, 24 Dec. 1715-8 Mar. [1716 ?]. Fr . Paper.

LETTERS of [Joseph] de la Tour Guion, Bishop of Cavaillon [afterwards Archbishop of Avignon], to Card. Gualterio; Rome, 5 Jan. 1707-4 Dec. 1725. Fr. Holograph. Partly in cipher, with decipherings. Two volumes. At f. 260, Vol. II., are drafts of letters of Card. Gualterio to the Bishop of Cavaillon; 17 May, 1708-22 July, 1719. Fr . Paper.

LETTERS of Alessandro Abbate Tamisier, to Card. Gualterio, on political and personal matters; Ravenna, Paris, etc ., 23 June, 1706-30 Aug. 1728. Fr. and Ital . Holograph, or in a secretary's hand. Some in cipher , with decipherings. Ten volumes. Paper.

LETTERS of Cardinal Francesco Acquaviva [Papal Nuncio in Spain in 1706, and afterwards Cardinal Protector of Spain and Minister of the King of Spain at Rome] to Card. Gualterio; 4 July, 1706-12 Dec. 1724. Ital . Chiefly holograph. Some in cipher , with decipherings. In some instances the letters are written on the margin of others received from. Card. Gualterio. Many, at the end, are undated. Five volumes. At the end of Vol. V., from f. 273, are drafts and copies of letters of Card. Gualterio to Card. Acquaviva; 14 Feb. 1706-12 Nov. 1718. Ital . Paper.
LETTERS of the Abbate Pietro Francesco Albicini to Card. Gualterio; 1707-1718. Ital . Holograph; a few in cipher , with decipherings. Six volumes. Paper.

LETTERS of Card. Pietro Otthoboni [Bishop of Ostia, Protector of France at the Court of Rome, etc .] to Card. Gualterio; Rome, etc ., 15 June, 1706-5 Oct. 1726. Ital. Holograph, or signed ; many in cipher, with decipherings. Two volumes. A letter of Giovanni Otthoboni to Card. Gualterio, Rome, 9 July, 1707, occurs at f. 129 of Vol. I.; and letters of Chappe, Knight of the Order of St. Lazarus, Secretary to Card. Otthoboni, Rome, 2 March, 1707-24 Jan. 1711, occur at f. 60 of Vol. I., and ff. 153, 179, 197, 207, 213, and 225 of Vol. II. French . Paper.

LETTERS of the Abbate Rainiero Simonetti [Auditor of the Nunciature of Naples, Governor of Masserano, subsequently Cardinal] to Card. Gualterio; Brussels, Naples, Osimo, Masserano, Rome, etc. , 24 April, 1706-11 June, 1724. Ital. Holograph. Some in cipher, with decipherings. Two volumes. Paper.

LETTERS of [Luigi] Marquis of Bentivoglio, to Card. Gualterio; Ferrara, 13 August, 1707-15 Dec. 1717. Ital. Holograph, or in a secretary's hand. Many in cipher. Two volumes. Included are letters from Giacinto Vicoli to ; Rimini, 19 June, 1708. Vol. I. f. 28; Stephano Antonio Benincasa to ; Ancona, 10 Dec. 1715. Vol. II. f. 232; Federico Maria Bentivoglio to Card. Gualterio; S. Elpidio, 17 May, 13 Sept. 1715. Vol. II. ff. 318, 320; Beatrice Bentivoglio Pepoli [daughter of the Marquis Ippolito Bentivoglio, sister of the Marquis Luigi, and wife of Count Ercole Pepoli] to the same; Rome, 9 March, 1711-31 Dec. 1712. Vol. II. ff. 322-341. Paper.

LETTERS of Count F de Vernon [Sardinian Minister in France, 1719-1723] to Card. Gualterio; Turin, Paris, etc ., 31 Jan. 1713-15 Jan. 1727. Ital . Holograph , or signed ; many in cipher . Included are a few letters of the Countess, his wife. Ital. Signed; and at the end of Vol. III. are two letters of his brother, "Il Cavagliere di Vernon;" Turin, 7 Aug. 1726, 12 Feb. 1727. Ital .: the former holograph; the latter signed . Three volumes. Paper.

LETTERS of D. Carlos Felipe Antonio Spinola Colonna [Marques de los Balbases, Viceroy of Sicily, etc .] to Card. Gualterio; Genoa, Palermo, Messina, Madrid, etc ., 8 Jan. 1706-19 Feb. 1721. Span. Signed; a few in cipher, with decipherings. Two volumes. Included in Vol. II. are also letters to the same from-Carlos Ambrosio Spinola de la Cerda [son of the Marques de los Balbases]; Madrid, 19 April, 1717, 2 Aug. 1721-25 Jan. 1727. Span. Signed. ff. 152, 352; Juana Spinola y la Cerda [daughter of the same]; Madrid, 20 Feb., 20 Oct. 1725. Span. Signed. f. 364; D. LETTERS of the Marques de Villamayor [Spanish Ambassador at Turin, etc .] to Card. Gualterio; Turin and Genoa, 15 Sept. 1703, 5 Aug., 2, 9 Sept. 1704, 25 Nov. 1713-10 Sept. 1721. Spanish. Holograph or signed; a few in cipher, with decipherings. Amongst them are a few written by his secretary, Francesco Antonio Rico. Two volumes. Paper.

DRAFTS of letters of the Archbishop of Myra, as Papal Nuncio at Naples, to the Papal Secretary of State, to be written in cipher, or in answer to letters in cipher; 21 April, 1744-13 March, 1753. Ital . In a secretary's hand; with corrections. Two volumes. Paper.

DRAFTS and copies of letters of Card. Gualterio to Card. de la Trémoille; 26 Dec. 1706-3 Dec. 1716. French ; a few in Italian . Included are a few letters in cipher , deciphered, without signature, addressed to the Card. de la Trémoille; 14 July, 1708-25 Jan. 1709. Fr . and Ital . They have been endorsed by a secretary of Card. Gualterio, "Plusieurs lettres en chiffres et dechiffrées anonimes. Elles peuvent etre de M. de Cauaillon [Joseph de la Tour Guyon, Bishop of Cavaillon ?] ou lui auoir eté écrites;" but they have no resemblance to M. de Cavaillon's letters. ff. 24-41. Paper.

LETTERS of du Bourg [Chargé d'Affaires at the Court of Vienna] to Card. Gualterio; 28 Nov. 1716-7 Oct. 1719. Fr . Portions of some of the letters in cipher. Signed. f. 1. 2. Drafts of letters of Card. Gualterio to M. du Bourg; 10 Apr. 1717- 24 Oct. 1719. Fr . ff. 207-224. Paper.

LETTERS in cipher , and decipherings of letters, of Card. Valenti to the Archbishop of Myra, while Papal Nuncio at Naples; 1 Jan. 1744-4 Sept. 1753. Ital . Paper.

LETTERS of [Giuseppe Alessandro Furietti] to L. Gualterio, Archbishop of Myra, relating to political affairs; 25 Jan. 1746- 1 Aug. 1747; with some undated. Ital . In cipher , with decipherings, and a key prefixed. Paper.
